entities.name: Dhiren Baral
entities.description: A human Consulate officer in Ghirapur who hunted Chandra Nalaar and her family, was disfigured, later imprisoned, and finally pardoned.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whose spark ignited when Baral tried to execute her at Ghirapur.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's family member who Baral stabbed and murdered.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Captive tormented by Baral, who told her he had killed her daughter.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Chandra against Baral and talked her down.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who used Baral to steal inventions and distract Chandra.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A vedalken who supervised Baral's operation and later charged him with crimes.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: Ally of Chandra who sent a filigree bird to stop Baral.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: Skyship pirate captain who rescued Baral from Phyrexians and recruited him.

entities.name: Ragavan
entities.description: Kari Zev's First Mate, assigned to watch Baral.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The governing authority of Ghirapur that Baral served.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Rebels who took control of the central Aether Hub of Ghirapur.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City on Kaladesh where Baral served and where Chandra's spark ignited.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane Baral defended; Avishkar is the continent with Ghirapur.

entities.name: Bunarat
entities.description: Village where Chandra and her parents hid, torched by Baral.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Plane Chandra first planeswalked to.

entities.name: Dhund
entities.description: Prison where Baral was imprisoned.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: Uprising in which the Renegades took the central Aether Hub.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: Phyrexian attack that damaged Baral's prison and let him escape.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who confronted Baral after his escape.

events.summary: Baral, secretly a mage, is tasked to prosecute Chandra for fire magic and continues hunting the renegades; he stabs Kiran and torches Bunarat.
events.quote: He stabbed Kiran Nalaar in the stomach and torched Bunarat

events.summary: Baral tries to execute Chandra at Ghirapur; her spark ignites, she planeswalks to Regatha, and Baral's face is burned.
events.quote: the threat ignited her planeswalker's spark and she planeswalked to Regatha

events.summary: The Consulate demotes Baral from captain to lieutenant.
events.quote: the Consulate demoted him from captain to lieutenant

events.summary: Baral torments captive Pia Nalaar and traps Nissa, Chandra and Oviya in a Deadlock Trap.
events.quote: he managed to trap the three in a Deadlock Trap

events.summary: Baral helps Tezzeret steal inventions and abduct inventors from the Inventors' Fair.
events.quote: Baral later helped Tezzeret steal the best inventions

events.summary: Tezzeret orders Baral to distract Chandra, with Dovin Baan supervising; Baral lures Chandra away until Nissa blocks him and Baan picks him up.
events.quote: Baral began to taunt Chandra, luring her away from her companions

events.summary: Baral beats Chandra down, admits he murdered Kiran, and drives her to self-implode; Nissa talks her down and Baral flees.
events.quote: Baral admitted to her that Kiran Nalaar had not died in the fire

events.summary: Baan charges Baral with murder, attempted murder, and other crimes; he is imprisoned in the Dhund.
events.quote: Dhiren Baral was imprisoned in the Dhund

events.summary: During the Phyrexian assault Baral escapes his damaged prison and is confronted by Phyrexians.
events.quote: he wasted no time in making his escape

events.summary: Kari Zev rescues Baral and forces him to join her, with Ragavan watching him.
events.quote: Kari Zev assigned her trusted First Mate Ragavan to keep a close watch on Baral

events.summary: The new Consulate overlooks Baral's past offenses because of his defense of Kaladesh.
events.quote: the new Consulate chose to overlook Baral’s prior offenses and transgressions

relations.quote: an even more obsessive hatred of the Nalaars
Kiran had been murdered by the Consulate officer

relations.note: helped and was ordered by Tezzeret
relations.quote: Tezzeret ordered Baral to distract Chandra
